name: botz-mcp-swarm
description: Connect to the central Botz MCP Swarm server (https://swarm.botz.ai/mcp, OAuth sign-in) and go from introspection to optimisation with the botz MCP Swarm CLI: point swarm at any MCP server and it builds, runs and scores the tests for you.

interface.longDescription: Connects your agent to the central Botz MCP Swarm server (https://swarm.botz.ai/mcp, OAuth 2.1 sign-in) and ships skills for the botz MCP Swarm CLI: introspect live MCP servers and generate suites from tool schemas, annotations and intents, run contract/schema checks, evals and load tests centrally or locally, get optimisation recommendations, register distributed VU/OTEL workers, diagnose failures, and upgrade saved suites.
